details:
Q1. What specific part of this repository should change? If you know the exact target, include the workflow, script, or file path/name in your reply.
Choices:
A. I know the exact target and will name it in my reply (RECOMMENDED)
B. Clarify / plan / implement pipeline
C. Review / autofix / orchestrate / validate pipeline
D. Docs / README / templates
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect behavior or a failing workflow
B. Improve reliability / speed / cost without changing behavior
C. Add or change functionality
D. Improve docs / wording / onboarding
E. Not sure — I will describe the current problem and desired outcome in 1–2 sentences (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete example can anchor the work?
Choices:
A. A workflow run, PR, issue, or log snippet showing the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A short current-vs-expected behavior example
C. The exact text, file, or template that is wrong or missing
D. I do not have an example; use the smallest safe improvement in the area named above
